fusions.name: Run Down
fusions.desc: A closing blow that deals 24 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit. It leaves the target [Inescapable] for 4 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Quarry Ring
fusions.desc: Draws a ring 5 tiles wide around you that deals 14 damage to every enemy in it and leaves each [Marked] for 8 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Baying Pack
fusions.desc: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 40% further. A pack of hounds fights beside you for 25 seconds, striking for 3 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Scent Bound
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 12% more damage. Your armour rises by 5%.
